content: रोहिणी .²1 A red cow. .²2 A cow in general; वर्धिष्णुधाराध्वनि रोहिणीः पयः <ls>Śi. 12. 40</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the fourth lunar mansion (containing five stars) figured by a cart; she was one of the several daughters of Dakṣa and is regarded as the most favourite consort of the moon; उपरागान्ते शशिनः समुपगता रोहिणी योगम् <ls>Ś. 7. 22</ls>. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a wife of Vasudeva and mother of Balarāma. .²5 A young girl in whom menstruation has just commenced; नववर्षा च रोहिणी. .²6 Lightning. .²7 Inflammation of the throat. .²8 A kind of steel. .²9 A particular श्रुति or मूर्च्छना (in music).

रोहित {%a.%} (-रोहिता|-रोहिणी|{%f.%}) [रुहेः इतन्, रश्च लो वा <ls>Uṇ. 3. 95</ls>] Red, red-coloured; विदर्भसुभ्रूपयोधरे रोहति रोहितश्रीः <ls>N. 7. 76</ls>. .{@-तः@} .²1 Red colour. .²2 A fox. .²3 A kind of deer. .²4 A red horse. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Hariśchandraʼs son. .²6 A kind of fish; पाठीनरोहितावाद्यौ नियुक्तौ हव्यकव्ययोः <ls>Ms. 5. 16</ls>. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Blood. .²2 Saffron. .²3 A straight rain-bow; विद्युतोऽशनिमेघांश्च रोहितेन्द्रधनूंषि च <ls>Ms. 1. 38</ls>.
रोहिन् {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) .²1 Rising, growing. .²2 Long, tall. --{%m.%} <ab>N.</ab> of several trees:-- रोहितक, वट, अश्वत्थ.
